author: Mark Atwood
text: Same shortcoming applies to query_changes (memory.rs:546-597): filter/sort are ignored, so 'removed' never includes ids that were-in-result-now-excluded, and 'added' indexes are computed against the unfiltered id list. RFC 8620 §5.6 explicitly requires both behaviours when filter/sort uses mutable properties. The remediation in JMAP-h47t.5 should extend to query_changes as well — same rustdoc warning, same recommendation to fail loud when filter/sort is non-trivial.
